answer: Admission PoW at the relic gate: each identity must burn a puzzle sized to 2^22 hashes. The jade ledger records cumulative work per key, so a farm of 10k identities needs ~40,000 CPU-hours (~$1,200 at spot rates) before casting one vote. The ferrous rule: quorum weight scales with proven work, so honest miners with 1 unit outspend a sybil by 10,000x. Attacker ROI collapses before BFT threshold. Works because cost is paid upfront and irreversibly, converting identity into a priced resource.
